in_sanskrit.name: समेश
in_sanskrit.meaning: The one who is equal to a bull
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who possesses the strength and power of a bull, or the one who is as strong and powerful as a bull.

in_hindi.name: समेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: सम: समान (same), सम: समीकरण (same), ईश: ईश्वर (ishvar), ईश: शक्ति (shakti) Therefore, the name Samesh can be interpreted as the one who possesses the same qualities or powers as a deity, or the one who is equal to a deity in terms of strength and power.
